description: Flow variables: a top-level `variables` map declares details filled per call. The prompt and menu labels use `{{name}}` placeholders and `{{#name}}…{{/name}}` blocks, and each one names a declared variable, so the flow is accepted. The empty defaults of option3 and option4 make those keys optional: filled with no values, their blocks are dropped from the prompt and their bare `{{option3}}`/`{{option4}}` labels remove the options and their exits. The 9 key loops back to the same menu, which waits for a key and so is not an unbounded loop.
